title: ChockHookPayload
description: V3 hook payload: the compiled gate DSL under 'hook.gate', the event declaration under 'hook.script' for a check no declarative kind can express, or both -- the same control on its git events and its tool_use surface. A script and a shell guard (implementations/<policy_id>.{sh,py}, found by name) never see an Edit/Write; their write-path door is a hook.gate whose 'on' includes tool_use: kind script for logic, or a path gate (content_regex, forbidden_path_regex, content_pattern '(?!)'). DET-6, spec/script-backed-gates.md.

outside_repo.description: Globs (absolute or starting with ~) of files outside the repository whose writes this gate may judge, at PreToolUse only. Needs tool_use in 'on'.

params.description: Per-kind params are validated by checks_gate.

script.description: A check that cannot be expressed as a gate kind, run by the installed hook from implementations/<policy_id>-<event>.{sh,py}. No kind and no params: the behaviour is the script's. No message either -- the script prints its own refusal, with the detail only it has. 'on' is authoritative: the compiler wires exactly these events, and the validator fails when a declared event has no script or a script is undeclared. Git events only: a script never runs at tool_use, tool_call, stop or in CI; declare the write path as a hook.gate (DET-6).
